labPage.eyebrow: The Lab — ASEAN's first computerized pool water analysis
labPage.heroSub: A computerized lab measures eleven parameters of your pool's chemistry and returns a real treatment plan — not a guess.
labPage.pullQuote: “Because you never know what lies beneath the sparkling blue water in your swimming pool.”
labPage.whyTitle: Bad water doesn't look bad. It just makes you sick.
labPage.whyBody: Out-of-balance pool chemistry quietly causes a long list of problems for the people who actually swim in it. Our lab catches these before they reach you.
labPage.measureTitle: Eleven parameters. One report. Real recommendations.
labPage.processTitle: Three ways to get your water tested.
labPage.step1Desc: Drop a sample at any of our eleven branches. We test on the spot and walk you through the results before you leave.
labPage.step2Desc: Our technicians can pick the sample up from your pool. Written results and recommendations come back within seven days.
labPage.step3Desc: Computerized analysis turns into a precise treatment plan — exact products, exact doses — to bring water back into balance.
labPage.closingBody: Visit any of our eleven branches across Thailand, or contact us to arrange a sample collection.

servicePage.eyebrow: Services — Pool care, end to end
servicePage.heroSub: From a single water problem to a full maintenance contract — handled by the technicians who've worked on Thailand's pools for two decades.
servicePage.svc01Desc: Our laboratory specialists analyze eleven variables of your pool's chemical balance and tell you exactly whether the water is in ideal condition to swim in. You leave with a precise plan — not a guess.
servicePage.svc02Desc: Premium Australian products, applied by people who have done this for two decades.
servicePage.svc03Desc: Routine maintenance tailored to the way your pool actually behaves — full vacuum, water balancing, equipment checks. Your pool stays in tip-top condition.
servicePage.svc04Desc: Year-round pool servicing delivered by highly-trained technicians. Casual or contracted.
servicePage.svc05Desc: Diagnose and solve any pool water problem — quickly, effectively.
servicePage.closingBody: Tell us what you need and we'll get the right technician to your pool.

franchisePage.profileP1: J.D. Pools has been in the swimming pool business for over twenty years, building more than fourteen thousand pools in Thailand. We were the first Thai company to export pools, and now ship a wide range of products to more than twenty countries.
franchisePage.profileP2: Twenty showrooms around the country provide construction, installation, and maintenance services across every customer segment.

franchisePage.retailP1: More pools means more demand for accessories and maintenance. Pool Pro&Lab combines a full retail and wholesale store with a state-of-the-art water analysis laboratory.
franchisePage.retailP2: Treatment recommendations are based on premium Australian imported pool care products — the most advanced available.

howToApplyPage.eyebrow: How to apply — Six steps to opening
howToApplyPage.heroSub: A clear, predictable process. The whole thing takes around four months from signed agreement to open doors.
howToApplyPage.step1Desc: Complete the franchise application form and send it to the Franchise Manager.
howToApplyPage.step2Desc: We review preliminary qualifications and schedule an interview with the franchise team.
howToApplyPage.step3Desc: If the preliminary qualifications meet our standard, we share the full business details.
howToApplyPage.step4Desc: Both sides sign the franchise agreement.
howToApplyPage.step5Desc: A comprehensive training course for you and your staff — products, services, operations, and business management.
howToApplyPage.step6Desc: Office decoration to spec, equipment installation, and a Pool Pro&Lab staffer on-site to coach the start of operations.
howToApplyPage.closingBody: Get the application form and start the conversation with our franchise team.

faqsPage.heroSub: Everything you'd ask before signing a franchise agreement — and a few things you didn't think to ask.

decoration.q: How long does the shop decoration take before opening for business?
decoration.a: About four months from the time the franchise agreement is signed and the location is confirmed.

investment.q: What will the franchisee get in return for its initial investment?
investment.a: Shop decoration to prototype standard (depending on location), all essential equipment and facilities, signage and supplies, marketing and advertising support, staff training, and continuous operational support.

minOrder.a: It depends on the location. Our franchise team will walk through the specifics with you during the initial meeting.

location.q: Will the franchisor assist in location selection?
location.a: Yes. We have a team of experts who recommend viable locations, can negotiate rental rates on your behalf, and have prime sites available.

process.q: What is the franchise application process?
process.a: Six steps: application form, initial interview, financial assessment, contract signing, training program, and finally outlet decoration and opening.

training.q: What training does Pool Pro&Lab provide?
training.a: Two phases. Phase one is at our head office, covering products, services, and operations. Phase two is on-site at your outlet, with a Pool Pro&Lab staffer coaching you through the beginning of operations.

support.q: What ongoing support is available after opening?
support.a: Outlet management, operations, marketing, procurement, accounting and legal, business consultation, and research and development — all on tap.

expand.q: Can I expand my franchise to multiple locations?
expand.a: Yes. Pool Pro&Lab wants each franchisee running a full-time business with ownership success. Franchisees have the right to extend when ready.

faqsPage.closingBody: We'll walk you through the program, the economics, and what running a Pool Pro&Lab actually looks like.

businessContactPage.formBody: Background, location interest, timeline — whatever you've got. We'll respond with the application form and the next steps.
